content_sections.title: Background and event
content_sections.body_text: Use the past continuous for a background action: I was walking when my friend called. Keep the main event clear.

content_sections.title: Polite support
content_sections.body_text: A: Could you help me explain the timetable? B: Yes. I was reading it when you arrived. Stress the important word.
